content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working on a project where I need to provide certain data points to a customer. To start, I set up Modbus points on two separate [product_name] devices to test communication between them. Both were configured as Modbus-compatible devices to mimic the real-world setup. I configured one device as a server with a client connection, and the other as a client with a server connection. I also added a simple digital input set to network output. Currently, I am unable to get the devices to communicate. Any guidance would be appreciated.
